status: Optional unfunded research proposal; no outreach, purchase or permission grant executed
purpose: Test whether expert agents can construct inclusive source uncertainty models at lower total effort than competent existing methods while answering unchanged scientific questions.
required_access: One rights-cleared archive family and independently qualified domain context; the restricted Zenodo payload is not an available input.

design.development: A small disjoint source set used to define interpretation and refusal procedures; exclude all evaluation answers.
arms: competent human-led uncertainty model using existing tools
design.adjudication: Independent domain audit of source inclusion, calibration dependence, error budgets and final scientific claim; treatment-blind where practicable.
primary_outcomes: complete source modeling and validation effort
buyer outside option and conditional price

budget_basis: USD planning estimate: BLS median wages 65.38, 67.45 and 58.93/hour respectively; employer factor 1.46 and separate overhead 20%; not a quote or measured duration.
accounting: Optional C research investment, including separate source access, evaluation and rejected attempts; not paid-job learning, earned revenue or available network funds.

stage_gates.acceptance: Authorized records and sufficient context for all arms
Source-family procedure and all treatment policies frozen before fresh pages
stage_gates.stop: Strong prior art already meets the exact source contract with no credible effort gap

stage_gates.acceptance: Every eligible question and failure retained; complete effort logs
stage_gates.stop: Any unsupported accepted claim, silent query change or budget exhaustion

stage_gates.acceptance: Useful answers, credible participation and full-cost advantage versus the strongest comparator
stage_gates.stop: No useful accepted answer or no defensible cost/value advantage

permissions: Read and compute only within separately authorized source access. Any human recruitment, payment, commercial contract or production-scope change requires its own supported authorization. No live ENS, on-chain action or automatic retention admission.
success_probability: Unknown; 0.20/0.50/0.80 may be tested as decision sensitivities, not assigned as measured probabilities.
financing: No funds allocated. Existing actual customer collections are zero and actual complete research costs unknown. Do not infer available growth funds from a simulation.
